newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fergie opens car show in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Fergie opens car show in Germany.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York opened an international car show on Friday as part of a high-profile publicity tour after launching her autobiography "My Story".
Dressed in a purple suit and thronged by journalists, Sarah Ferguson, who was divorced from Queen Elizabeth's second son Prince Andrew last May, read her opening speech in faltering German.

"Fergie", as she is known after her unmarried name, is trying to find a way to pay off huge bank debts and is said to be carving a deal to become an American TV talkshow host, according to the Hollywood trade paper Daily Variety.
It was not clear if she was paid for her appearance at the Essen car show.

Pictures of Fergie, have graced the covers of most German womens' magazines in the last few weeks. A television interview with American comedienne Ruby Wax was also shown in Germany with the voices dubbed into German.
Fergie has given numerous media interviews to publicise her book which paints an unflattering picture of Britain's royal family.
